hypothesis: RUNTIME surface, trigger-level observability, closing the 2026-08-03 crystallize incident class: the job failed at 19:50, the desktop swallowed the child's stderr into eprintln (invisible from Finder), state recorded only status=error, and the exact error was UNRECOVERABLE — plus is_due never retries, so the failure sat silent until the next weekly slot. Three additive layers: (1) JobRun gains `last_error` (stderr tail of the last failed run, cleared on success), `runs_total`, `failures_total`, `consecutive_failures` — recorded by a single `State::record_outcome` used by both tick and run-now, seeded runs don't count, counters carry over across state rewrites. (2) ShellRunner tees the child's stderr line-by-line (still forwarded to eprintln for launchd logs) while keeping a bounded tail (12 lines / 2048 bytes) that becomes JobResult.error_tail — bounded so schedule-state.json can never bloat on a runaway child. (3) /api/schedule exposes the four fields and the System page's automation panel shows a failure strip on last_status=error: consecutive count, lifetime fail ratio, the stderr tail, and the honest 'no automatic retry — waits for the next scheduled window' note (the is_due contract, previously documented only in CLAUDE.md). Predicted: the next scheduled failure is diagnosable from the portal alone — no ssh, no log spelunking, no rerun-and-hope.

predicted_delta.operational_reliability: MEASURABLE: forced-scheduler-failure diagnosability goes 0/1 under v2 (state records only status=error; the 2026-08-03 crystallize post-mortem verdict was 'exact error unrecoverable') to 1/1 under v3 (the same forced failure surfaces its stderr tail + streak via /api/schedule and the System automation failure strip). Deterministic pass condition: run-now a job with a failing argv → GET /api/schedule returns non-null last_error containing the child's stderr text and consecutive_failures >= 1; a following ok run returns last_error=null and consecutive_failures=0 (covered by record_outcome_tracks_counters_and_error_evidence).

guardrails.additive_state: all four JobRun fields are serde-default — existing schedule-state.json files load unchanged and old binaries ignore the new fields on read
guardrails.bounded_evidence: the stderr tail is capped at 12 lines / 2048 bytes BEFORE it enters state; a runaway child cannot bloat schedule-state.json
guardrails.stderr_still_flows: teeing must not eat the stream — every line is still forwarded to the parent's stderr for launchd/log-file capture
guardrails.seeded_neutrality: the seeded placeholder run counts as neither a run nor a failure; counters start at the first real execution
guardrails.success_clears: an ok run clears last_error and resets consecutive_failures but never rewinds runs_total/failures_total
